item.title: Snow monkeys bathing in hot springs get health benefits
item.description: Snow monkeys stay warm in hot spring baths. These baths also affect their parasites and gut microbes. It's a cozy way to get a health benefit! The post Snow monkeys bathing in hot springs get health benefits first appeared on EarthSky.

item.title: Notice the westward shift of Orion and all the stars
item.description: As Earth makes its grand tour around the sun each year, the stars and constellations all do a westward shift in our sky. Orion is a good one to notice. The post Notice the westward shift of Orion and all the stars first appeared on EarthSky.

item.title: New dinosaur named for iconic Korean cartoon character Dooly
